listing.name: Auto-er Pilot
listing.summary: Improves autopilot steering by utilizing gates, slipstreams, and hazard avoidance for long-distance travel.
listing.aiSummary: Improves autopilot steering by utilizing gates, slipstreams, and hazard avoidance for long-distance travel.

description:
My mods are fully AI created mods that I created for my own playthroughs and have posted since I use them every time I play, and figured someone else may also find some use for them. If you use them and find any issues, stemming from either AI development wonkiness or just oversight on my part, let me know in the comments here or on github, either is fine, and I'll try to get things fixed quickly. The biggest advantage to slop is speed.

Auto-er Pilot
Autopilot steering for Starsector 0.98.5a.

Source code
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional and only adds the settings menu.
Updating: Extract the new zip over the old folder in mods/. Saves and settings carry over.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove mid-game

No required mods

Short summary
This mod aims to mirror how NPC fleets drive themselves and also tries to utilize gates in order to make the standard autopilot much better (at least during long-distance travel from planet to planet or station to station). In-system it doesn't have much functionality at all.

What it does
Storms
It'll slow down when it sees a storm and try to dodge around it, which is configurable in settings. Slipstreams
A cool function. If it sees a slipstream that's going towards your destination, it will try to get on it and ride it there if it will save it some time. If it isn't on the way and it says it crosses its path, it'll just try to cross right over it.
Reverse Polarity
If you have reverse polarity it's smart enough to turn it on and use slip streams backwards. Sustained Burn
It has automatic functionality for sustain burn and it will try to turn it back on if it gets turned off or if you take control for a minute. Though if you turn it off yourself by hitting the key, then it will turn off and stay off.
Hazards and fleets
Tries to avoid coronas, black holes from pulling you in, and bigger stronger fleets (anything with more points than you have). Also if there's a star that is the target of the system, it will stop outside of the corona of the star so your fleet doesn't get damaged. Really it'll try its best to. If there is a pulsar beam moving you around, it'll drop to a normal burn to try and get out of there, then uses emergency burn if that still didn't work. If that still fails it'll transverse jump you out. Asteroids
It slows down in asteroid fields to not have drive bubble impacts.
Jump points
It gets rid of the jump point dialog unless there's something on the other end that might blow you up. Gates
It'll automatically use gates if you have already discovered and reactivated them, if you have the Janus device, or if you have a mod that enables the gates in some other way. But as long as the vanilla gates themselves are activated and you can fly through them and use them, then this will automatically do so if it can, if the course is faster to use them.
Taking control back
Pretty much doing anything outside of just letting go of controls (such as trying to move or click on anything outside of the autopilot) will give you control back. To resume just click on your planet or station again and hit the autopilot key or just hit the autopilot key. Settings
In the F3 LunaLib menu there is a bunch of settings to configure so you can make things as sensitive or as blunt as you want, as far as how it steers, as well as disabling and enabling different features.

Compatible mods
AoTD - Vaults of Knowledge
Autopilot with Gates
Random Assortment of Things

Permissions
Code: Do whatever you want with it. It's AI slop code.
Assets: The Autarch AI Core portrait (the mod list icon) is mine (made with Midjourney) and follows the same rules as the code.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Forum post text: Hand-written, Mjolniar.
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: The mod icon is the Autarch AI Core portrait from Auto Colonies, made with Midjourney.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Colonies | Auto Outfitting

aiDescription: Enhances the standard autopilot to better navigate long distances between planets and stations. It automatically uses gates if available, rides slipstreams when beneficial, and avoids hazards like storms, black holes, and hostile fleets. The mod also handles sustained burn toggling and jump point dialogs intelligently.
